item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The only input key that gets special routing is a keyword literally named `prediction`.","span_ids":["e1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"That special routing activates only when `prediction` is a dict whose `type` is `'content'` and that contains a `content` key.","span_ids":["e1","e4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"For a matching `prediction` payload, `_forward_preprocess()` removes it from normal predictor kwargs and puts it into `config['prediction']`, and `forward()` sends that config as LM kwargs.","span_ids":["e2","e3","e4"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"Any other `prediction` value, including a plain string passed through a signature field named `prediction`, is not forwarded as an LM kwarg and instead remains in the ordinary predictor input path.","span_ids":["e1","e3","e5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":171,"end_line":176},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":177,"end_line":180},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":243,"end_line":253},{"span_id":"e4","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":898,"end_line":907},{"span_id":"e5","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":909,"end_line":915}]}
